open_questions: Allocator pairing: fn_080ab65e (0x080ab65e) is not a plain malloc (it calls a helper at 0x080ab624). FS_FileCompare (0x0809f3c8) releases its buffers with libc free(), and FS_LoadPackFile uses fn_080ab65e memory with the Z_Free-style fn_080ab5b8 elsewhere. Confirm whether the helper prepends a header, which would make the raw free() wrong.

Zip-reader placeholders (fn_080d1f69, fn_080d22a1, fn_080d2821, fn_080d2a03, fn_080d2a35, fn_080d2e9e, fn_080d3094, fn_080d3384, fn_080d3506, fn_080d224e, fn_080d1ef8) are assumed to be minizip-style unzip operations; the handle object is typed void * here. Confirm with chunk owners of 0x080d1xxx-0x080d4xxx.

Dead trailing arguments: several call sites pass an extra argument the callee never reads (for example FS_ListFiles and FS_ListFilteredFilesInList take unusedArg; FS_AddFileToList is called with four arguments at its caller). The binary's frame layout confirms the push, but the real parameter count of 0x080a13bc and 0x080a1b94 should be checked against callers in other chunks.

FS_AddIwdFiles: the binary's name array is declared with 1023 slots but written up to index 1023. Reconstruction uses 1024 slots; verify the stack layout to see whether the extra slot overlaps another local.
FS_ShiftedKeyProbe (0x0809f626): the strstr() result is discarded and the key copy has no bound. Confirm whether this is a dead probe in the shipped binary or the tail of a larger check.
Global roles still uncertain: g_0849fd70 (rand()+1 seed), g_084a8760, g_0849fc20 and fs_restrict (0x0849fd60). Their names are placeholders or guesses.
Pack referenced byte (+0x310) is not initialised in FS_LoadPackFile; correctness relies on the allocator zeroing memory. Verify fn_080ab65e zero-fills.
